findings: An unauthenticated client can read/write every document under the local catch-all rule. Specific collection rules cannot tighten an already allowed catch-all.

Replace with default-deny rules, owner-scoped passenger data, assigned/approved operator writes, immutable identity and server-controlled rewards; validate with Firebase Rules Emulator. Verify what is actually deployed separately.
The live journey emergency callback only shows 'Emergency services contacted.' No call, message or service request is performed.

Implement a reviewed contact/dial flow with truthful initiated/failed states, or remove the action until implemented. Confirm the appropriate contact through authoritative local sources before configuring it.
Live journey sends users to the wrong assistance target
Both assistance actions open const BoardingAssistanceScreen(), using its default bus_138_outbound, st_fort and three-minute arrival, even while viewing another bus or stop.
Pass the actual bus ID, boarding/alighting stop ID and name, route label and measured ETA; require target review. Test another route and a shared stop.
Assistance can appear sent without reaching the driver

createBoardingRequest caches first and swallows Firestore errors; the form then says sent and closes. Request status updates do the same. Its local-stream listener does not forward local events to the yielded stream.
Use acknowledged delivery states and a durable owner outbox. Add a passenger request-status stream with acknowledged/completed/cancelled states, failed-write UI and meaningful offline handling.
Missing telemetry is presented as working equipment

LiveJourneyScreen defaults missing ramp/elevator telemetry to true and renders 'Verified active on this vehicle'. It does not subscribe to condition reports/StatusLogic for the live accessibility panel.
Reuse scoped evidence and freshness logic in the live screen; represent equipment as Unknown until checked, and separate vehicle ramp evidence from stop elevator evidence.
Normal search bypasses route evidence and journey persistence

_onSelectRoute navigates directly to LiveJourneyScreen. No production callers of RouteDetailsScreen or JourneyConfirmationScreen were found. The improved evidence card is therefore disconnected from the normal search flow; JourneyService.createJourney is in the unused confirmation screen.
Connect results -> route evidence -> explicit journey confirmation -> persisted journey -> live tracking. Preserve bus/stop IDs, selected date and time. Test restart/resume.
Community mutations change local reports first, award/deduct local stats, then catch cloud errors. The details screen still reports confirmation or resolution success.
Return acknowledged results or queue explicit pending mutations; propagate rejection; update public evidence and rewards only after acknowledgement. Keep resolution audit records.
Driver updates and trips can succeed only locally

updateBusAccessibility, TripService start/arrival/complete and LiveBusService updates swallow write failures. Driver UI announces updated/active/completed states without reliable shared acknowledgement.
Make operator writes report success/failure; keep local GPS visible as local only; reconcile retries and show broadcasting acknowledged/stale/offline states. Add cross-device failure tests.
Operator role and bus assignment lack trusted approval

Registration accepts an operator role from the user. _claimBusAssignment writes the current user's ID directly onto the bus, including already assigned buses; protection is a UI check and the permissive rules.
Decide approved-operator enrolment and assignment policy. Enforce it in backend rules/transactions; prevent reassignment without permission; eliminate operator_dev identities in real flows.
Missing report timestamps become fresh now
Report.fromMap uses DateTime.now() if createdAt is absent/invalid. Malformed or legacy evidence can look newly checked and pass freshness tests.
Represent unknown observation time explicitly or reject invalid records; never refresh missing evidence during parsing. Add missing/invalid timestamp fixtures.
Unknown ramp condition defaults to working
Bus.fromMap defaults missing rampOk to true; wheelchairAccessible is hasRamp && rampOk. A record listing a ramp but no operational check can enter accessible results.
Separate capability from observed operational condition with nullable condition/time/source; treat absent check as Unknown for requirement matching.
Sample services are exposed as real fallback transit data

FirestoreService preloads sample buses/routes and returns SeedData stations when remote data is empty or unavailable. Reports are now separated from demos, but service availability, schedules and equipment flags are not.
Add explicit demo mode and provenance for transit catalogues; preserve acknowledged cache offline and show no data/stale states instead of substituting demo services.
Concurrent votes and rewards can lose updates

confirmReport/flagReport read a document then overwrite complete arrays/counts using set, not a transaction. UserService.updateUserStats similarly computes totals from a prior read. Parallel clients can overwrite each other's changes.
Use transactions or authoritative server operations for votes and idempotent reward events. Test simultaneous votes, duplicate retry and reversal.
Stop alert promises a notification without detection
_toggleAlert only flips a bool and shows a snackbar. No use of that bool for stop proximity or notifications was found.
Implement stop-index/proximity detection, once-only foreground alerts and clearly scoped background delivery, or mark the control unavailable.
Conditions do not refresh when time alone passes

Freshness is calculated during build/stream events; results/feed/evidence do not have a clock-boundary or resume refresh. With no data event, a 30-minute crowding badge can remain on screen after expiry.
Rebuild at the next expiry/recheck boundary and on app resume, sharing a clock where possible. Test a visible report crossing expiry without Firestore events.
A previous confirmer cannot perform a later recheck
Both UI and service exit if confirmedBy already contains the user. The same commuter cannot refresh an unresolved fault on a later trip.
Separate unique vote totals from dated check observations; permit later recheck under a reasonable interval without awarding repeat voting rewards.
Final-stop arrival needs an extra confirmation to complete
confirmNextStopArrival completes only when nextIndex >= stops.length. Confirming arrival at the last valid index still returns in_progress; a further press is needed.
Complete on arrival at the final stop, retaining its actualArrival; atomically stop broadcasting. Test two-stop and multi-stop trips.
Operator overnight estimates do not roll into the next day

TripService.startTrip parses every schedule time on actualDepTime's date. A 23:50 then 00:10 itinerary produces the latter estimate earlier than departure. PassengerJourneyPlan handles rollover separately.
Share ordered schedule parsing between operator and passenger journeys, and clarify actual-versus-planned departure adjustments.
Deleted telemetry can remain in local cache

LiveBusService returns cached location after a remote document is missing, and its all-active snapshot handler does not remove cached buses absent from the snapshot. A later local event can reintroduce old broadcasting records.
Invalidate on authoritative remote deletion/empty active snapshots; retain stale cache only when explicitly offline and labelled accordingly.
Local outbox lacks retention and account cleanup
Outbox JSON includes report text and pending image bytes in SharedPreferences and retains all entries. Published entries remain in the map, and no cleanup/user deletion policy was found.
Bound retention, remove acknowledged entries when safe, add pending-report cancel/delete and account-scoped cleanup; evaluate private file storage for images and protect sensitive notes.
Accessibility settings use global SharedPreferences keys; logout does not reset or load account-specific preferences. A second rider on a shared phone inherits the previous rider's requirements.
Choose explicit device settings versus account travel needs; scope personal needs by UID with guest defaults and reload on auth changes.
Scheduled minutes are labelled as live bus movement
Results label buses Ongoing/Approaching/isLive from departure-time differences without live GPS. A scheduled bus that never starts can look live.
Use schedule wording until fresh operator telemetry confirms movement. Keep timetable estimates separate from live tracking.
Accessible empty-state recovery button is unreachable
The empty state checks _selectedFilterTab == '♿ Accessible', while the actual tab value is 'Accessible'. The intended Show All Buses button cannot appear.
Use one typed tab value and provide a useful recovery action without silently dropping wheelchair/step-free requirements.
Ticket prices are model estimates with incomplete disclosure
PassengerJourneyPlan uses an invented duration/stops formula, while route cards render bare LKR amounts. The unused details page also has an independent fixed ticket-price card.
Clearly label estimates and their source/limitations; replace with an authoritative fare dataset if available, and share the selected segment fare across all screens.
Unused confirmation screen contains fabricated live/verified data

JourneyConfirmationScreen can create operator_system telemetry at hard-coded coordinates/speed and displays fixed verified-ramp statements. It has no current callers, so this is a dormant risk rather than a reproduced production flow.
Remove demo writes from production and replace static verification before reconnecting this screen for F06.
read.md lists TTS voice navigation and QA DOCX/XLSX deliverables, while voice guidance is disabled and those artifacts were not found in the workspace inventory.
Reconcile README/read.md, onboarding and pitch claims with a tested feature inventory. Mark planned capabilities and external evidence links explicitly.
